prompts.q: close the data & site updates notice
open the topics tab, then go back to the wonder systems tab
open the underlying cause of death database
when was this page last reviewed
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/October 14,? 2026/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }

prompts.q: what databases are listed under national notifiable conditions
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/NNDSS Annual Summary/i, /NNDSS Annual Tables/i, /NNDSS Weekly Tables/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 2; }

prompts.q: what does the triangle symbol next to a link mean
prompts.check: (card) => { const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer, ...(card.rows || [])].join(" "); return [/numerical data/i].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 1; }
